text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, thank you!
Man, being at the top really is the best.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, and the time after that—
I'll blast ahead and show 'em who's 'strongest.'"
choice_data_list: Let's keep going without letting our guard down.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, leave the next one to me too!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoops. Hey, I'm starving, wanna grab some food?
Let's go eat meat, MEAT!
choice_data_list: I thought you'd say that, so I booked a table at a yakiniku place.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!?
That's my partner for ya, you get it!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: All right, let's hurry and change so we can get this celebration started~!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I know, I know.
I ain't gonna fool around.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If ya don't hit it head-on with everything ya got,
it ain't got no meanin'—
choice_data_list: Let's pick another race with fired-up rivals next time, then.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: That's what makes one the "strongest," isn't it?
